args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks following the v2.3.1 production deploy. Initial rollback to the last known-healthy release (v2.3.0) partially failed (orchestrator error after us-east), leaving us-west and eu-west on the unhealthy v2.3.1 with ~18% error rate. Re-ran rollout of v2.3.0 to all regions; service is now healthy across us-east, us-west, and eu-west with error rate down to 0.2%. v2.3.1 needs investigation before re-deployment.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

**Rollback:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy. I identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production and rolled back to it. The initial rollback partially failed (orchestrator error after us-east), leaving us-west and eu-west on the unhealthy v2.3.1, so I re-ran the rollout of v2.3.0 to all regions. Service is now healthy everywhere: us-east, us-west, and eu-west all on v2.3.0, with error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.

**Incident:** The incident creation call initially timed out, but I verified it actually went through — **INC-0001** (SEV2, open) is on record for checkout-api describing the v2.3.1 regression, the partial rollback failure, the recovery, and that v2.3.1 needs investigation before any re-deploy.
